title: The Alchemist (Beta Branch)
description:
[quote]This mod is for the beta version of the game. Here is the public version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781688551[/quote]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ 90+ new cards
[*] 💎 9 new relics
[*] 🧪 10 new potions
[*] 📚 7 timeline epochs
[*] 🎨 Handmade art and animation [i](WIP)[/i]
[*] 🌍 Translated into 15 languages
[*] 🐸 You get to be a frog
[/list]

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Self-Poison[/b]: The Alchemist doses themselves on purpose. Some attacks deal additional damage based on your Poison and other cards listen for how often your Poison is triggered.
[*] [b]Antitoxin[/b]: A reserve that absorbs the damage your Poison would deal to you. It is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
[*] [b]Mix[/b]: These are tokens you can create in combat that are similar to potions. The basic Mixes are Bursting (damage), Syrupy (Block) and Zesty (draw); the special Mixes are Fuming (Weak and Vulnerable), Acrid (Poison) and Sparkling (Energy).
[*] [b]Ferment[/b]: These cards grow in potency for every turn they stay in your hand.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: This Rest Site option allows you to procure 1 of 7 unique potions that can only be obtained this way. Due to the quality of these brews, the Merchant is willing to buy them from you for 150 Gold.
[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
This mod is still a work in progress and content is subject to change, but feedback is welcome! The best place to discuss the mod is official Slay the Spire Discord server in the #modding-forum.

The Alchemist has been lovingly crafted to feel like a natural addition to the game. Every card, relic, and potion has been (and will continue to be) balanced against the existing game. The same care extends to flavor and lore: this character's story is woven directly into the game's existing timeline, and observant players will find more than a few threads connecting them to the world.
